title: DS2 0x2A Soft-BSL entry
user_description: Adds DS2 command 0x2A as a normal-mode entry into the persistent Soft-BSL loader on MS41.1 while leaving the standard 0x43 adaptation-clear command intact.
description: V2 enforces the resident Soft-BSL loader dependency. MS41.1 unknown-command splice -> enter flash mode (E740=1 + commit + reset) -> reboot to the SA1 0x5A loader. Leaves 0x43 clear-adapts intact.
